entries.2ccc5de5c63bbb13: A company that provides solutions such as logistics and payment processing to mail-order businesses, and also operates mail-order sales of apparel and miscellaneous goods and e-commerce for individuals.
entries.6a551ef0ff8cbfd4: This is a mail-order business for apparel, innerwear, sundries and other products. In addition to the company, Scroll International Co., Ltd., Shikeraku Shōbō (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., SCROLL VIETNAM COMPANY LIMITED and SCROLL BANGLADESH COMPANY LIMITED are in charge of it. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥36,662 million.
entries.9366003aada85c67: This business consists of the logistics business of the Group and the solutions business, and the real estate leasing business. In addition to the company, Scroll Logistics Co., Ltd. is in charge of operating logistics facilities. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥288 million.
